report.summary: The report's sourcing is sound overall. All 56 tagged claims are either fully supported or partially supported by the cited pages, with partial instances typically involving multi-tag sentences where each tag covers a portion of the claim. No unsupported or wrong-source tags were found, and no untagged checkable specifics were identified. The report faithfully reflects the DRHP content.
